?:?:_Z14eval_far_batchPN4gicc9DeviceCtxE.rationale: 512 total ops (8 blocks x trip_count 64). Proxy concurrency = min(grid_blocks 8, lanes 8) = 8, so per-lane cost 5.37 + 64*2.872 = 189 us, while the single host DWQ must stage all 512 descriptors serially: 7.88 + 512*1.033 = 537 us. Grid width fully covers the proxy lane budget, so proxy is ~2.8x cheaper.

?:?:_Z16eval_reuse_batchPN4gicc9DeviceCt.rationale: grid_blocks=1 gives proxy no lane parallelism: 5.37 + 32*2.872 = 97.3 us versus trigger 7.88 + 32*1.033 = 40.9 us. Batch of 32 is far past the n~1.4 crossover, and descriptor_reusable=true plus constant 4096B size favors host-staged DWQ release.

?:?:_Z16eval_tiny_singlePN4gicc9DeviceCt.rationale: Single 256B op, one block: proxy 5.37 + 2.872 = 8.24 us vs trigger 7.88 + 1.033 = 8.91 us. n=1 is the only regime below the fixed-cost crossover, so proxy is marginally best; margin is small (~8%) hence moderate confidence.

?:?:_Z17eval_large_singlePN4gicc9DeviceC.rationale: 8 x 1 MiB puts are bandwidth bound (8 MiB / 24 GB/s ~ 350 us), so issue overhead is ~2-5% of wall time. Proxy still edges trigger (8.24 us across 8 lanes vs 16.1 us serial staging) with no lane contention since grid_blocks=8 equals the lane budget.

?:?:_Z19eval_adjacent_batchPN4gicc9Devic.rationale: 16 ops from a single block, so proxy is confined to one lane: 5.37 + 16*2.872 = 51.3 us vs trigger 7.88 + 16*1.033 = 24.4 us. Coalescable constant-size 4096B batch amortizes the higher trigger fixed cost roughly 2x.

?:?:_Z19eval_dynamic_offsetPN4gicc9Devic.rationale: Only proxy is legal here; hk_capable=false and max_vector_bytes=1 mean the descriptor cannot be host-reconstructed for DWQ staging.

?:?:_Z21eval_static4_parallelPN4gicc9Dev.rationale: Four independent static sites, 4 blocks each = 16 producers over 8 lanes, giving 2 issue rounds: 5.37 + 2*2.872 = 11.1 us for the whole kernel. Routing any site to trigger serializes 4+ descriptors on the single DWQ (>=12 us) and raises the critical path, so uniform proxy across distinct lanes is best.

Same launch context as the sibling sites: independent static sites get distinct proxy lanes, and 16 producers over 8 lanes cost 5.37 + 2*2.872 = 11.1 us in parallel, beating any mix that pushes 4-op batches onto the serial host DWQ (>=12 us).

Uniform proxy keeps all four sites on separate lanes; per-site 4 ops with grid_blocks=4 issue concurrently, total 2 lane rounds = 11.1 us, versus 24.4 us if all 16 constant-size 4096B ops were staged serially through DWQ.

Identical facts to the other three static sites; lane-parallel proxy issue (min(4 blocks, 8 lanes) per site, 16 producers over 8 lanes) yields the shortest critical path at ~11.1 us and avoids adding ops to the single serial trigger queue.
